verdict.rationale: Saving and sharing filtered views is a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents saved views, saved filters, or shareable view links. The closest item is an MCP example query ("Find all my incomplete tasks due this week"), which is a one-off natural-language search, not a persisted view shared by link.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
